messages:
alex: Heads up — bringing up strandline-7b (mistralx-derived) and seeing weird token/rotary coupling after converter + int8 quant. hallucination and summary quality drop :eyes:
priya: Can you paste the converter command + model config you used?
alex: converter cmd: `python convert.py --src mistralx --dst redwood --model strandline-7b --map head_graft.json --vocab map.tsv`
alex: config snippet:
```
rotary: { type: 'headwise_graft', head_map_file: 'head_graft.json', phase_scale: 1.0 }
vocab_offset: 0
quant: { mode: 'int8', per_channel: true }
```
cheng: Did you check token ids align with our qwen tokenizer? we've seen vocab shadowing where merged BPE ops shift ids, which bites embeddings.
alex: Ran `compare_token_ids.py --a qwen-tokenizer.json --b strandline-tokenizer.json --report top50` — got a 0.6% id shift. Example: token 'Ġthe' maps to a different id near the tail.
sam: 0.6% can be enough for embedding drift. Also head_graft can misapply rotary frequencies if head ordering differs between forks.
priya: Any eval numbers (ppl, rouge, winrate) you can share?
alex: Baselines:
- orig (no quant): pplx=11.8, rougeL=29.3
- quant-only (no graft): pplx=11.9, rougeL=29.1
- graft+quant (current bad run): pplx=13.4, rougeL=25.2 — big regression on SummEval
cheng: That smells like a two-hit: vocab id collisions -> embedding noise, plus wrong per-head rotary phase -> attention pattern shift.
sam: Quick checks I ran: dump first-layer embeddings for token id 42 across converted vs reference: `np.allclose(e_conv, e_ref, rtol=1e-4)` -> False. Runtime log also shows intermittent kvcache warnings: `kvcache: shape mismatch head=12 expected=64 got=63` on some batches.
alex: Repro script: `python repro/strandline_onboard.py --prompt-file small_eval.txt --model /tmp/strandline/converted --quant int8 --check-embed` writes mismatch CSV and sample generations.
priya: Proposed mitigation plan:
1) apply vocab remap/offset during conversion when tokenizer diffs detected
2) canonicalize head ordering in converter (sort by original_head_index) before writing head_graft.json
3) add runtime fallback: if rotary.phase_scale missing, set to model_meta.rotary_scale or compute per-head scale heuristic
sam: Also add an importer guard: sample N tokens, compute cosine sim between converted vs reference embeddings; fail onboarding if avg_sim < 0.98. Cheap smoke to catch this early.
cheng: I'll patch converter to emit a `vocab_fixup.tsv` when collisions found and add canonicalization step for head_map. Will push soon.
ci-bot: deploybot: Created CI job `eng-ml/rotary-vocab-smoke` — runs converter roundtrip + embed/rotary sanity checks on new model PRs. timeout=15m.
alex: After applying vocab remap + canonical headmap locally: pplx=11.8, rougeL=28.9 (quanted). SummEval winrate +4pts. latency ~ unchanged. :thumbsup:
priya: Nice. Please open a PR with conversion logs, before/after eval artifacts, and the repro output.
alex: Will do — attaching diffs and unit test for headmap roundtrip.
cheng: Once merged run `eng-ml/rotary-vocab-smoke` across recent onboards (zephyr, orion, orbis) to catch similar issues.
sam: Filing follow-up ticket INFER-4123 for runtime fallback + longer-term rotor-phase autodetect.
alex: Thanks all — will follow up in PR and tag you.
